arxiv-2212-06904.title: A Near-Infrared Pyramid Wavefront Sensor for the MMT
arxiv-2212-06904.creator: Jacob Taylor, Suresh Sivanandam, Narsireddy Anugu, Adam Butko, Shaojie Chen, Olivier Durney, Tim Hardy, Masen Lamb, Manny Montoya, Katie Morzinski, Robin Swanson
arxiv-2212-06904.description: Abstract The MMTO Adaptive optics exoPlanet characterization System (MAPS) is an ongoing upgrade to the 6.5-meter MMT Observatory on Mount Hopkins in Arizona. MAPS includes an upgraded adaptive secondary mirror (ASM), upgrades to the ARIES spectrograph, and a new AO system containing both an optical and near-infrared (NIR; 0.9-1.8 µm) pyramid wavefront sensor (PyWFS).

arxiv-2306-02559.title: Efficient Exact Enumeration of Single-Source Geodesics on a Non-Convex Polyhedron
arxiv-2306-02559.creator: Kazuma Tateiri
arxiv-2306-02559.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kazuma Tateiri. In this paper, we consider enumeration of geodesics on a polyhedron, where a geodesic means locally-shortest path between two points. Particularly, we consider the following preprocessing problem: given a point s s on a polyhedral surface and a positive real number r r , to build a data structure that enables, for any point t t on the surface, to enumerate all geodesics from s s to t t whose length is less than r r .

arxiv-2409-07660.title: Hidden Bose-Einstein Singularities in Correlated Electron Systems
arxiv-2409-07660.creator: Takafumi Kita
arxiv-2409-07660.description: Abstract Hidden singularities in correlated electron systems, which are caused by pair fluctuations of electron-electron or electron-hole bubbles obeying Bose-Einstein statistics, are clarified theoretically. The correlation function of each pair fluctuation is shown to have a bound in the zero Matsubara frequency branch, similarly to the chemical potential of ideal Bose gases.

arxiv-2412-15858.title: Bayesian pulsar timing and noise analysis with Vela.jl : an overview
arxiv-2412-15858.creator: Abhimanyu Susobhanan
arxiv-2412-15858.description: Abstract We present Vela.jl , an efficient, modular, easy-to-use Bayesian pulsar timing and noise analysis package written in Julia. Vela.jl provides an independent, efficient, and parallelized implementation of the full non-linear pulsar timing and noise model along with a Python binding named pyvela .

arxiv-2501-15954.title: Pressure robust finite element discretizations of the nonlinear Stokes equations
arxiv-2501-15954.creator: Lars Diening, Adrian Hirn, Christian Kreuzer, Pietro Zanotti
arxiv-2501-15954.description: Abstract . We present first-order nonconforming Crouzeix-Raviart discretizations for the nonlinear generalized Stokes equations with ( r , ε ) (r,\varepsilon) -structure. Thereby the velocity-errors are independent of the pressure-error; i.e., the method is pressure robust. This improves suboptimal rates previously experienced for non pressure robust methods. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 35J62,35J92,65N30,65N12,65N15,76A05,76M10 1.

pmc-11451458.title: Association Between Opioid and Benzodiazepine Use and All-Cause Mortality in Individuals with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-11451458.creator: Hao Jiang, Xiaomin Zhang, Jian Zhang, Jie Liang, Liping Wang
pmc-11451458.description: BackgroundOpioids and benzodiazepines are frequently prescribed for managing pain and anxiety in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) patients. This study aimed to determine whether opioid use, with or without benzodiazepine use, is associated with increased all-cause mortality in COPD patients.MethodsThis prospective cohort study included adults aged ≥20 years with COPD from the US National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2007–2012.

pmc-11458413.title: Case Report: Primary ciliary dyskinesia due to CCNO mutations: a Chinese pediatric case series and literature review
pmc-11458413.creator: Lejun Tong, Li Li, Wenjian Wang, Jiehua Chen
pmc-11458413.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD) is a hereditary disorder characterized by defects in cilia that impair mucociliary clearance. This study focuses on PCD caused by mutations in the Cyclin O (CCNO) gene and reports on three cases involving Chinese children. Case 1 was an 8-year-and-3-month-old boy who presented with respiratory distress after birth and later developed a recurrent productive cough and purulent nasal discharge. He was initially diagnosed with diffuse panbronchiolitis (DPB) due to the presence of diffuse micronodules in lung CT scans.

pmc-11651096.title: Deep learning enabled integration of tumor microenvironment microbial profiles and host gene expressions for interpretable survival subtyping in diverse types of cancers
pmc-11651096.creator: Haohong Zhang, Xinghao Xiong, Mingyue Cheng, Lei Ji, Kang Ning
pmc-11651096.description: The tumor microbiome, a complex community of microbes found in tumors, has been found to be linked to cancer development, progression, and treatment outcome. However, it remains a bottleneck in distangling the relationship between the tumor microbiome and host gene expressions in tumor microenvironment, as well as their concert effects on patient survival.

pmc-12528722.title: Genetic variance in the murine defensin locus modulates glucose homeostasis
pmc-12528722.creator: Stewart W C Masson, Rebecca C Simpson, Harry B Cutler, Patrick W Carlos, Oana C Marian, Belinda Yau, Meg Potter, Søren Madsen, Kristen C Cooke, Niamh R Craw, Oliver K Fuller, Dylan J Harney, Mark Larance, Gregory J Cooney, Grant Morahan, Erin R Shanahan, Melkam A Kebede, Christopher Hodgkins, Richar
pmc-12528722.description: Insulin resistance is a heritable risk factor for many chronic diseases; however, the genetic drivers remain elusive. In seeking these, we performed genetic mapping of insulin sensitivity in 670 chow-fed Diversity Outbred in Australia (DOz) mice and identified a genome-wide significant locus (QTL) on chromosome 8 encompassing 17 defensin genes.

pmc-12649326.title: Antibiotic Use in the Community in Spain: A National Surveillance System Within the Framework of the Spanish Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance
pmc-12649326.creator: Rocío Fernández-Urrusuno, Carmen Marina Meseguer-Barros, María García-Gil, Itxasne Lekue-Alkorta, María Belén Pina-Gadea, María Ana Prado-Prieto, Natalia Alzueta-Isturiz, Lucía Jamart-Sánchez, Laura Villar-Gómara, Antonio López-Navas, Marc Maresca
pmc-12649326.description: Background: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) remains a critical major public health challenge, largely driven by the inappropriate use of antibiotics in the community. In Spain, the National Action Plan on AMR (PRAN) emphasizes the need for robust surveillance systems based on standardized indicators and high-quality data sources.

pmc-13287668.title: Temporal relationship between physical activity, social anxiety, and internet addiction among adolescents: a cross-lagged analysis
pmc-13287668.creator: Xianbang Huang, Ling Li, Song Wang
pmc-13287668.description: Physical activity (PA), social anxiety (SA), and internet addiction (IA) are closely related to adolescents’ psychological and behavioral development, yet their longitudinal directional association Responses to Editor and Reviewers. This study examined the temporal predictive relationships among PA, SA, and IA in adolescents using a cross-lagged panel model.

pmc-13352849.title: Intellectual and moral well-being as dimensions of human flourishing: the development and validation of a multidimensional scale
pmc-13352849.creator: Claudia E Vanney, Belén Mesurado
pmc-13352849.description: This study developed and validated an expanded multidimensional measure of flourishing that incorporates moral and intellectual well-being. Two studies were conducted with university students in Argentina. Study 1 (N = 560) used exploratory factor analysis to identify a 20-item, five-factor structure comprising emotional, social, psychological, moral, and intellectual well-being.

pmc-13427493.title: Parahenipavirus langyaense (Langya virus): Spillover ecology, noncanonical receptor-mediated entry, and future control strategies
pmc-13427493.creator: Liang Shen, Yanfei Tong, Wenqi Chai, Jiali Sun, Jianzhong Zhao, Lijuan Yin, Yang Yang, Chunhua Wang, Wenjie Tan, Ji Zhang
pmc-13427493.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Langya virus (LayV), classified in the species Parahenipavirus langyaense, is a newly identified zoonotic paramyxovirus discovered in febrile patients in eastern China in recent years. The discovery of LayV has expanded the field beyond the prevailing paradigm of highly pathogenic, bat-borne henipaviruses represented by Nipah virus (NiV) and Hendra virus (HeV), toward a parahenipavirus spillover model shaped by shrews, rodents, and agricultural ecological interfaces.

pmc-13618008.title: Decoding Vascular Senescence: Cellular Insights and Therapeutic Strategies
pmc-13618008.creator: Mengyuan Gao, Chongjin Zhong, Jiajia Shen, Sainan Peng, Xue Zhou, Qiuhong Shen, Cheng Qian, Xinming Yang, Yuxuan Gong, Kang Zhang, Yin Lu, Xiaodong Shu, Yang Zhao
pmc-13618008.description: Vascular aging is a dynamic biological process contributing to systemic organismal decay. This review elucidates the heterogeneous cellular phenotypes and microenvironmental remodeling across macrovascular and microvascular beds. These multifaceted pathological shifts are integrated into a unified tripartite framework of twelve hallmarks of vascular aging.
